cards.p: Write a friendly 2 sentence reminder for invoice [number], due [date]. Assume they forgot. Add my pay link [link].
Invoice [number] is [X] days late with no reply. Write a firm, kind follow up with a pay by date.
Turn these job notes into invoice lines with prices: [paste]. Flag anything I forgot to charge for.
Write a short note raising [service] to [new price] on [date]. One honest reason, a thank you, no apologizing.
Answer these customer questions in my voice, under 40 words each, with one next step: [paste].
Reply to this complaint: [paste]. Own the mistake in one line. Say how and when I fix it. No excuses.
Text [customer] to move from [day] to [option 1] or [option 2]. Apologize once. Let them reply 1 or 2.
Write an after hours auto reply: when I will answer, my booking link [link], one line for urgent issues.
Here is a lead's message: [paste]. Is it worth a call? Give me the first question to ask.
Write 3 short texts following up my quote for [job]. Friendly, useful, never desperate.
A customer says [service] costs too much. Give me 3 replies that hold my price.
Turn these notes into a one page proposal with 3 price tiers and one clear pick: [paste].
Give me 30 post ideas for my [business]. Each one answers a real question customers ask me.
Turn this 5 star review into 3 posts: a story, a lesson, a before and after: [paste].
Write my Google Business Profile description for [business] in [area]. Plain words, under 750 characters.
Give me 3 slow season offers that fill [month] for my [business] without cheapening the brand.
Write a 2 sentence text asking [name] for a Google review of today's [job]. Add my link [link].
Reply to this 5 star review in 2 personal sentences. Mention the detail they mentioned: [paste].
Reply in public to this 1 star review: [paste]. Calm, fair, offer to fix it. Under 80 words.
Read my last [X] reviews: [paste]. What do people love, what do they hate, what do I fix first?
I will explain how I do [task]. Turn it into a checklist a new hire can follow on day one.
Write a job post for a [role]: the daily work, must haves, pay [range], and 3 screening questions.
Sort my to do list into today, this week, delegate, and drop: [paste]. Be honest.
Turn these meeting notes into a table: who does what, by when: [paste].
